title: Angel Offering to Monk
description: A bald monk in a colorful patterned robe sits by a pond, drinking from a long yellow straw connected to a gourd. Two winged angels in matching robes float above, pouring golden droplets from a vessel toward him. The background features a swirling green cosmic vortex, dark mountains, lily pads, and two hands emerging from the water.
prompt: A surreal scene of a bald monk in green and orange patterned Japanese robes sitting on a stone by a pond, drinking through a long curved yellow tube from a gourd. Two identical winged angels with white wings wearing matching robes float above him, pouring glowing droplets. Cosmic green swirling vortex in the dark sky, mountains in background, lily pads, flowers, and two hands reaching up from the dark water.
